systems.name: Electronic Health Record / Electronic Medical Record
do_not_assume: Direct database access
Public patient-record APIs
Universal FHIR support
Permission to copy clinical records

systems.name: Laboratory Information System / Laboratory Information Management System
systems.purpose: Support laboratory workflows, specimens, testing, and results.
do_not_assume: All tests can be ordered online
Results can be displayed publicly
The system provides a modern API

systems.name: Picture Archiving and Communication System / Radiology Information System
systems.purpose: Support medical imaging storage, access, and radiology operations.
do_not_assume: Public imaging access
Direct website access to diagnostic images

systems.name: Appointment Scheduling System
systems.purpose: Manage appointment requests, availability, bookings, and cancellations.
do_not_assume: Real-time availability
Instant confirmation
Two-way integration

systems.name: Patient Portal
systems.purpose: Provide authorized access to patient-facing digital services.
do_not_assume: Portal functionality is part of the public website
All patients have portal accounts

systems.name: Remote Patient Monitoring Platform
systems.purpose: Receive and manage connected monitoring data and related workflows.
do_not_assume: Every device exposes an API
The website processes live patient readings
Automatic alerts follow universal clinical rules

systems.name: Customer Relationship Management System
systems.purpose: Manage inquiries, sales, relationships, and communication.
do_not_assume: The CRM is approved for protected health information
Every form should send data to the CRM

systems.name: Content Management System
systems.purpose: Manage website pages, media, content, and publishing workflows.
do_not_assume: The CMS should store clinical records
Every user should have publishing access

systems.name: Identity and Access Management System
systems.purpose: Authenticate users and support authorized access.
do_not_assume: One login works across all systems
Authentication alone grants access to patient data
